summary: Persist sanitized payment stage events in the canonical PaymentRecord and preserve verified rejection reasons.
reason: The Topnet adapter incorrectly relabeled a generic correlated rejection as bank_declined. PaymentRecord also exposed only terminal state, making the exact live branch unavailable after completion.

tests.name: topnet-live-adapter
tests.evidence: 8/8 direct node:test cases PASS, including generic rejection preservation, explicit bank_declined preservation and sanitized event forwarding.

tests.name: payment-core
tests.evidence: 51/51 cases PASS, including durable timeline, no token exposure and bank-return resume tracing.

capabilities.reason: Canonical capability truth is owned by ui-playbooks; runtime behavior implements that contract.

architecture.reason: Extends the existing PaymentRecord and existing runner event channel. No parallel log store or execution plane.

rollback: Revert this runtime commit and redeploy the prior Companion extension. Existing payment records remain valid because trace is optional and backward compatible.
limitations: Existing historical records do not acquire fabricated intermediate events.
The exact external reason for the pre-instrumentation Topnet failure remains unknown.
